text:
Type: balance-arm floor reading lamp
Use: reading light beside an armchair or a sofa; living room, bedroom, study
Style: industrial, classic, retro
Materials: nickel-plated steel shade, arm, pole and stepped round base, black cord with foot switch
Colors: brushed silver nickel, black
Shape: small dome shade at the end of a long horizontal swing arm with a knob counterweight, tall straight pole, heavy stepped base, light and linear
Feel: refined, studious, vintage, elegant
Goes with: leather armchairs, dark wood, bookshelves; classic studies, industrial or traditional living rooms

product.name: BAROMETER
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
